observed.identity: A 3D-rendered male figure with a slim build, seen mostly from behind and in profile.
observed.hairstyle: Short, neatly styled hair swept back from the face.
observed.clothing: A tan plaid two-piece suit with a white shirt cuff visible at the wrist and dark shoes.
observed.action: The figure stands still, then turns slightly, raises his right arm, and brings both hands up to his face in a brief gesture before lowering his arms and standing still again.
observed.camera: A static, low-angle full-body shot from behind and to the side of the figure.
observed.scene: A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy reflective floor, a large domed glass building with glowing teal rings on the left, and a white building with rows of lit windows on the right.
